Wrangell-Petersburg Census Area (retired 2008) split into Wrangell City and Borough + Petersburg Census Area/Borough. Shares are current (2025) land area of each successor as a fraction of their combined area -- assumes today's boundary exactly partitions the historical one (no third-party annexation), which matches the documented change. Population weights are not provided for this split: unlike CT's town-level crosswalk, apportioning population would require town/place-level 2020 population spatially joined against the *historical* Census Area boundary (not just the current successors' boundaries), which is meaningfully harder and no downstream consumer has asked for it. Deferred, not silently assumed area-equivalent to population.

Shares are current (2025) land area, same method as the other AK splits; population weights deferred for the same reason as the other AK rows.
